items.title: What Does Micron Technology (MU) Warning Of Shortages Through 2027 Mean?
items.summary: Micron Technology (NasdaqGS: MU) and Intel CEOs cautioned that memory chip shortages and higher prices could persist through 2027. Micron's leadership indicated on a recent call that supply constraints may only start to ease meaningfully from 2028 onward. Intel's CEO echoed the outlook for extended tightness in DRAM and NAND availability, pointing to heavy AI and data center demand.
